title: Fr\'echet regression of multivariate distributions with nonparanormal transport
abstract: arXiv:2603.07014v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Regression with distribution-valued responses and Euclidean predictors has gained increasing scientific relevance. While methodology for univariate distributional data has advanced rapidly in recent years, multivariate distributions, which additionally encode dependence across univariate marginals, have received less attention and pose computational and statistical challenges. In this work, we address these challenges with a new regression approach for multivariate distributional responses, in which distributions are modeled within the semiparametric nonparanormal family. By incorporating the nonparanormal transport (NPT) metric -- an efficient closed-form surrogate for the Wasserstein distance -- into the Fr\'echet regression framework, our approach decomposes the problem into separate regressions of marginal distributions and their dependence structure, facilitating both efficient estimation and granular interpretation of pre

translated_title: 多元分布的非参数正态输运弗雷歇回归
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2603.07014v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：以分布值响应和欧几里得预测变量进行的回归正日益受到科学关注。虽然单变量分布数据的方法论近年来发展迅速，但多元分布——它们还编码了单变量边际之间的依赖关系——受到的关注较少，并带来了计算和统计上的挑战。在这项工作中，我们通过一种新的多元分布响应回归方法应对这些挑战，其中分布在半参数非参数正态族内建模。通过将非参数正态输运（NPT）度量——一种用于Wasserstein距离的高效闭式替代——纳入弗雷歇回归框架，我们的方法将问题分解为边际分布及其依赖结构的独立回归，从而促进高效估计和精细解释。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合非参数正态输运度量的弗雷歇回归方法，用于高效处理多元分布响应，通过分解边际分布和依赖结构实现计算简便与可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Fréchet regression approach incorporating the nonparanormal transport metric to efficiently handle multivariate distributional responses by decomposing marginal distributions and dependence structure for computational ease and interpretability.
